description: Binance spot order book snapshot for one pair: best bid and ask, spread, USD depth within 1% and 2% of mid price (from the returned levels only), and 24h volume, change and high/low. Up to 100 levels per side. Snapshot only; Binance market data, not a merged multi-exchange book. Takes about 12 s; allow a 30 s timeout. Related tools on this server, for a different need: finance_binance_prices when you need Binance spot last price for one trading pair. Price: $0.003 per successful call, paid with x402 (USDC on Base, Solana and 10 more networks); failed calls are not charged.
